meta.title: Lahza | لحظة
meta.description: Short, friendly journeys through the Islamic moments you'll notice at work.

welcome.tagSub: From a moment of curiosity… to understanding
welcome.inviteB: Part of your onboarding: short, friendly journeys through the Islamic moments you’ll notice at work.
welcome.p2: We never ask about your religion
welcome.p3: Your progress stays on your device
welcome.aiNote: Sacred texts are quoted verbatim from approved sources. Simplified explanations are AI-generated and always labelled.

home.helloSub: Short moments that explain what you notice at work.
home.emptySub: A journey appears here once the team has reviewed and approved it.

journey.sceneHint: There is no right or wrong answer. Pick what comes to mind first.
journey.otherHeadline: Here is what is really happening
journey.aiFoot: A simplified explanation written by an AI model and reviewed by the project team. Not a religious ruling.
journey.explainSub: One or two sentences are enough. Writing it down makes it stick.
journey.explainOnDevice: What you write stays on your device.
journey.doneS: Your progress is saved on your device.
journey.badge: Approved by the project team, awaiting sharia review
journey.unapproved: Unapproved draft — shown in development only
journey.notFound: This journey is not available yet.
journey.fbAll: Your explanation covers all three points.
journey.fbNone: We did not find this moment's points in your explanation yet.
journey.fbRejected: Write the explanation in your own words, in a sentence or two, without copying the scene.
journey.fbUnavailable: We could not check right now. You can continue; here are the points of this moment.
journey.fbFoot: This note is automatic: an AI model matches your words to points the team reviewed, and writes no text of its own.

ask.title: Noticed something else?
ask.sub: Describe what you saw at work in your own words and we will point you to the right moment.
ask.label: What did you notice?
ask.placeholder: Example: my colleagues leave the meeting every day around noon
ask.privacy: We do not keep the text of your question or link it to you.
ask.found: This moment explains what you noticed
ask.candidates: One of these moments may help
ask.emptyTitle: We do not have a verified answer for this yet
ask.emptyBody: Lahza only answers from content a person has reviewed. Try other words, or browse the moments available.
ask.specialistBody: Some questions should not be answered by an app: personal rulings and matters scholars differ on. A qualified person should answer you.
ask.homeCardSub: Write what you saw and we will find its moment.

specialist.title: Contact a specialist
specialist.sub: Some questions should be answered by a qualified person, not an app. Write a short summary, edit it as you like, and nothing is sent without your consent.
specialist.topicLabel: What would you like to ask about?
specialist.topic_personal_ruling: A ruling about my own situation
specialist.topic_disputed_matter: A matter I have heard more than one view on
specialist.topic_about_islam: I want to know more about Islam
specialist.template_personal_ruling: I would like to speak with a specialist about a question that concerns my personal situation.
specialist.template_disputed_matter: I noticed something at work that I have heard more than one view on, and I would like a specialist to explain it.
specialist.template_about_islam: I would like to speak with someone who can explain Islam to me and answer my questions.
specialist.template_other: I have a question I could not find a moment for, and I would like to speak with a specialist.
specialist.contactLine: I would prefer to be contacted by:
specialist.summaryLabel: The summary the specialist will receive
specialist.summaryHint: This starting text comes from a fixed template, not from AI. Edit it in your own words, and leave out anything you do not want to share.
specialist.consent: I agree to send this summary to a specialist through my company. My name and no identifier are sent with it, other than what I wrote myself.
specialist.failed: We could not send it right now. Please try again shortly.
specialist.sentBody: A specialist will reach you the way you wrote. Lahza keeps nothing that links the request to you.
